svg.aria-label: Full-Stack Developer Intern, Techbase, Braga, APR 2024 - AUG 2024. React and TypeScript dashboards for 3CX Nexus, Node.js and Express REST APIs with JWT and MongoDB, and the caching work that cut external API load by 40%. CTeSP in Web and Mobile Development, ESTG, Felgueiras, 2022 - 2024. Higher professional diploma, 120 ECTS, including a software internship.
